items.title: 6403 CHELAN DR
items.description: Located in the desirable Cascades Community, this lovely brick Ranch is framed with mature trees on a .24-acre corner lot. Well-kept & thoughtfully upgraded, this inviting home offers 3 Bedrooms, 2 Baths, soaring ceilings, & open layout filled with natural light. Great Room features columns, wood floors, vaulted ceiling, fireplace, & opens to the eat-in Kitchen with tile floors, custom cabinetry, & stainless steel appliances. Formal Dining Room for gathering or entertaining. Primary Suite offers a versatile reading nook or home office area & luxurious private bath. Recessed lighting, crown molding, built-in speakers, & ceiling fans throughout. Enjoy outdoor living on the screened-in covered patio. Widened driveway provides additional parking. Amenities include: Pool, Lake, Clubhouse.

items.title: 10900 W ALEXANDER DR
items.description: Country living with space, versatility, and exceptional care! Set on 3.4 acres, this well-maintained 3,836 sq ft home offers 4 bedrooms, 3.5 baths, 3 fireplaces, an attached 2-car garage, detached garage, and an impressive 40x40 heated shop with electricity. The main level features a spacious kitchen with a new sink and range, multiple pantries, a butler's pantry, and rolling shelves in most cabinets. The finished lower level offers incredible flexibility for multigenerational living, guests, or a private retreat, with a fully equipped kitchen, bedroom, full bath, living room, family room with fireplace, bonus room, and separate entrance. Outside, expansive decking and a covered patio create wonderful spaces for relaxing and entertaining while enjoying the peaceful country setting. This home has been exceptionally well cared for and offers tremendous space, storage, and possibilities both inside and out. Buyers are responsible for verifying all data.

items.title: 1508 PARK DEVILLE PL
items.description: Well-kept and conveniently located upper-level condo in the desirable Park DeVille Subdivision, offering comfortable living, functional spaces, and a peaceful setting with easy access to many of Columbia's everyday conveniences. This 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom condo features an open and inviting floor plan, a 1-car carport, additional uncovered parking, and a newer HVAC system for added comfort and peace of mind. Step inside to the spacious living room, where the cathedral-style ceiling creates an open and airy atmosphere complemented by vinyl flooring and a gas fireplace (non-warranted) that adds warmth and character to the space. The living/dining room also provides direct access to the covered and screened-in back deck, creating a wonderful extension of the living space and an ideal place to enjoy your morning coffee or evening tea while overlooking the surrounding trees and peaceful natural setting. The kitchen offers plenty of cabinet storage, vinyl flooring, and bar-height countertops that provide additional seating and make entertaining or enjoying casual meals convenient. Just off the kitchen is the laundry and utility closet, with the washer and dryer potentially conveying with the property. The guest bedroom provides flexibility for family, guests, a home office, or other needs and features vinyl flooring, a spacious walk-in closet, and direct access to the back deck. The primary bedroom offers a comfortable retreat with vinyl flooring, a generous walk-in closet with plenty of room for clothing and storage, and access to its own private side deck. The primary bathroom includes vinyl flooring and a walk-in shower for added convenience. Additional storage is available on the upper level between the condo units, providing valuable space for belongings and seasonal items. Outside, the screened-in and covered back deck is one of the standout features of this condo, offering a serene backdrop of mature trees and a peaceful setting where you can relax, entertain friends and family, or simply enjoy a quiet moment at home. Located in a convenient Columbia location, this condo is close to Columbia Mall, shopping, restaurants, everyday amenities, gas stations, pharmacies, the University, local schools, and Interstate 70, making commuting and accessing the things you need simple and convenient. Whether you're looking for a comfortable place to call home, a low-maintenance lifestyle, or a conveniently located property close to everything Columbia has to offer, this Park DeVille condo is worth seeing. Come take a look and experience firsthand the comfort, convenience, peaceful surroundings, and well-maintained features this condo has to offer.

items.title: 4909 FORSYTHIA FALLS LP
items.description: Welcome to your private oasis in Magnolia Falls! This light-filled, quality custom built 4-BR, 2.5-BA home sits on a deep lot directly across from Magnolia Falls Park. Inside, enjoy BRAND-NEW CARPET and an open floor plan with peaceful nature views. The living room features a cozy fireplace with built-ins, flowing into a chef's kitchen with granite counters, a center island, smart lighting, and a new 2025 dishwasher. A butler's pantry connects to the formal dining room. Step outside to a lovely patio and a nicely fenced backyard perfect for pets, play, or relaxing. All bedrooms and the laundry room are conveniently upstairs. Don't miss this turnkey gem!

items.title: 1883 N WATERFRONT DR H
items.description: Back on the market after some amazing updates. Move-in ready low maintenance living in Edgewater II Condominiums! Seller is offering 3 months of HOA dues paid at closing! Upper-level 2 bed, 1.5 bath condo at 1883 N Waterfront Dr #H NEW PAINT! NEW FLOORING! Want it furnished? It's an option! Private balcony w/peaceful lake and pool views! Bonus storage space off the balcony, plus the convenience of both covered and uncovered parking. Option to purchase fully furnished! Effortless living. HOA covers water, sewer, trash, lawn care, snow removal, exterior maintenance, and gives you access to a full lineup of amenities--community pool, lake privileges, tennis, and basketball courts--all wrapped into an affordable monthly fee! Low maintenance living with all the amenities!

items.title: 2601 QUARTZ LN
items.description: Available for mid-term rental! Available for mid-term rental! Available for mid-term rental! Located in the highly desirable Greystone neighborhood, this move-in-ready 3-bed, 2-bath home features a split-bedroom floor plan, tall ceilings, a bright open layout, fresh interior paint, and no carpet. The spacious kitchen has brand-new stainless-steel appliances and opens to the formal dining area. The primary suite offers a walk-in closet, jetted tub, and separate shower. Enjoy a fully fenced backyard, attached 2-car garage, and quick access to Hwy 63 and I-70. Lease Requirements: 650+ credit 3x income No smoking/vaping Renter's insurance required Pets negotiable Tenant handles lawn care, snow removal

items.title: 301 W 5TH ST
items.description: Sellers are offering a $5,000.00 Concession for Rate Buy Down or to use however the buyer would like. Updated and ready for its new owners, this spacious two-story home offers an exceptional combination of versatility, functionality, and investment potential with 6 bedrooms and 6 bathrooms thoughtfully arranged to provide three bedrooms and three bathrooms on each level. Designed with flexibility in mind, both floors offer their own living spaces, kitchens, laundry access, and egress, creating an ideal setup for a large household, extended family, guests, or those looking for additional income-producing opportunities. The main-level kitchen features wood cabinetry, laminate countertops, and a stove, vent hood, garbage disposal, and dishwasher, while the upper-level kitchen offers wood cabinetry, laminate countertops, a stove, vent hood, garbage disposal, dishwasher, and refrigerator. Numerous important updates have been completed over the years, including the back deck and stairs in 2019, replacement of the wraparound porch in 2020, an overhauled used Carrier AC unit installed for the upstairs in August 2024, replacement of the upstairs water heater in September 2024, and major exterior improvements completed in January 2025, including a new roof, siding, soffit, fascia, and gutters throughout the home. Situated on a double lot, the property provides an abundance of backyard space for outdoor activities, entertaining, barbecues, gatherings, recreation, or simply enjoying the outdoors, along with the added convenience of private off-street parking. Location is another major highlight, with the property just one block from Westminster College and downtown, placing residents close to shopping, dining, schools, gas stations, local amenities, and convenient access to U.S. Highway 54. Previously utilized as a duplex, this property has demonstrated rental-income potential and could potentially be converted back to a duplex configuration, making it an intriguing opportunity for investors, owner-occupants seeking additional income, or buyers looking for a flexible property that can adapt to their needs. With its spacious layout, extensive updates, double-lot setting, prime location, and potential for residential or investment use, this unique property offers plenty of possibilities and is ready for its next chapter. Come take a closer look and discover everything this versatile home has to offer.

items.title: 16 GIPSON CT
items.description: Spacious and move-in-ready raised ranch located in the desirable Parkade Subdivision, tucked away in a convenient cul-de-sac setting. Offering 6 bedrooms, 3.5 bathrooms, an attached 1-car garage, and additional parking, this home provides an abundance of space, functionality, and flexibility for everyday living, entertaining, or accommodating a large household. As you enter, the inviting living room features durable vinyl flooring, large windows that fill the space with natural light, and plenty of room to gather, relax, or entertain. The adjoining dining area also features vinyl flooring and offers generous space for a large dining table, making it an ideal setting for family meals, holidays, and gatherings with friends. The kitchen is designed with functionality in mind and features stainless steel appliances, freshly painted cabinets, ample cabinet storage, and a convenient laundry hookup located within the closet. An exterior access door from the kitchen provides easy access to the backyard and outdoor living areas. The main level also includes a spacious family room highlighted by a large window for additional natural light and a fireplace (not warranted) for added ambiance, creating a comfortable space for movie nights, entertaining, family gatherings, or simply relaxing at the end of the day. A convenient half bathroom is located in the hallway, while the attached garage provides additional storage and everyday convenience with exterior access. Upstairs, you'll discover all six bedrooms and three full bathrooms, providing plenty of room for family members, guests, a home office, or other flexible living arrangements. The bedrooms are thoughtfully positioned throughout the upper level, with bedrooms on each side offering the convenience of attached bathrooms. Two of the front bedrooms provide access to the upper balcony, creating a peaceful outdoor retreat where you can enjoy your morning coffee, unwind after a long day, entertain guests, or simply take in the changing seasons. A full bathroom is also conveniently located in the upstairs hallway. One of the bedrooms on the right side of the home offers an abundance of windows for natural light, an attached bathroom, and direct access to the back patio, providing an exceptional combination of comfort and convenience. Outside, the fenced backyard offers plenty of room to enjoy and entertain, while the concrete patio creates an excellent space for a fire pit, barbecue, outdoor dining, or gatherings with family and friends. With its spacious floor plan, multiple bathrooms, generous bedroom count, attached garage, upper balcony, fenced backyard, and cul-de-sac location, this home offers a unique combination of space and convenience. You'll also appreciate the quick access to everyday amenities, including shopping, gas stations, schools, universities, and major transportation routes such as I-70. Whether you're looking for a home with room to grow, plenty of space for guests, or versatile areas for work and entertainment, this Parkade property is ready to welcome its next owner. Come take a look and discover everything this spacious home has to offer!

items.title: 1709 GLENBROOK CT
items.description: Where timeless design meets effortless entertaining. Beautifully updated & filled with natural light, this exceptional home sits on nearly an acre just minutes from the Katy Trail & Bonnie View Nature Sanctuary. The remodeled kitchen is the heart of the home, featuring granite countertops, high-end stainless appliances, gas range, wine fridge, oversized island, and walk-in pantry, all open to the inviting hearth room with soaring vaulted ceilings. Enjoy the screened porch, composite deck (2021), and private tree-lined backyard. The finished lower level offers a rec room with wet bar, media/flex room, 2 bedrooms, full bath, & storage. New roof (2026), 2 high-efficiency HVAC systems, and 2 water heaters (2022 & 2023). 3-car garage. Gather. Entertain. Relax. Explore! Buyer to verify all data.

items.title: 4317 STEVENDAVE DR
items.description: Huge opportunity to add square footage in the unfinished basement and lots of improvements already made. Rear entry 1 car garage and fenced front yard. Three bedrooms, 1 bath, newer windows and HVAC, new front door and most all interior doors have been replaced, and new light fixtures. Great storage and newer laminate flooring in living area, kitchen and hallway. Refrigerator and washer/dryer convey. Quiet and on a dead end street with light through traffic.

items.title: 2016 LOVEJOY LN
items.description: Sellers are offering Concessions for Rate Buy Down or to use however the buyer would like. Updated, renovated, spacious, and ready for its new owner, this beautiful Mid-Century Split-Level home in the desirable Tanglewood Subdivision offers an abundance of living space, modern updates, and convenient access to many of the amenities that make this area so appealing. Featuring 5 bedrooms, an additional office, 3 full bathrooms, and a 2-car carport, this home provides the flexibility and functionality for comfortable everyday living, entertaining, working from home, and hosting family and friends. The main level welcomes you into a spacious living room and dining room combination, creating an inviting open area for both relaxation and entertaining. Large sliding glass doors provide an abundance of natural light and lead directly to the upper deck overlooking the front yard, while durable waterproof laminate flooring throughout the main living areas offers easy maintenance and peace of mind. The living and dining areas flow naturally into the beautifully renovated kitchen, which features new cabinetry, quartz countertops, stainless steel appliances, recessed lighting, and a large island complete with a sink, dishwasher, and bar-stool seating. An updated light fixture above the island adds an attractive finishing touch, while the waterproof laminate flooring and convenient exterior door provide easy access to the backyard. The primary bedroom offers its own comfortable retreat with durable vinyl flooring, sliding doors leading to the upper front deck, and plenty of natural light. An accent wall and decorative tear-drop ceiling lights on either side of the bed create an inviting atmosphere and add character to the space. The spacious walk-in closet provides ample storage, while the renovated primary bathroom features a walk-in shower with tile extending to the ceiling, tile flooring, an updated vanity, and updated lighting. An additional upstairs guest or family bedroom provides even more flexible living space. Downstairs, the finished basement expands the home's functionality with three additional bedrooms, an office, a renovated guest bathroom, laundry room, and generous storage. The basement hallway features waterproof laminate flooring, while the bedrooms offer carpeting for a warm and comfortable feel. One of the basement bedrooms includes its own exterior door, providing additional access and convenience. The dedicated office features waterproof laminate flooring and offers an ideal space for working from home, studying, or pursuing hobbies. The renovated guest bathroom includes a tub with tile extending to the ceiling, an updated vanity, and an updated light fixture. The laundry room includes a washer and dryer that convey with the property, while the spacious storage area provides plenty of room for personal belongings, seasonal items, and additional organization with shelving already in place. Outside, the property continues to impress with a full front deck overlooking the large front yard, creating a welcoming outdoor space to enjoy your morning coffee or relax at the end of the day. The back deck provides direct access to the kitchen and offers an excellent setting for grilling, barbecues, and outdoor entertaining. An additional parking pad near the front of the home provides convenient parking for guests and family, while the large backyard offers plenty of room for gatherings, recreation, entertaining, gardening, or simply enjoying the outdoors. A fire pit near the side porch creates the perfect spot to gather with family and friends as the cooler fall weather arrives. For those who enjoy an active outdoor lifestyle, the home is conveniently located near creeks, trails, and Albert Oakland Park, where you'll find walking and recreational trails, ball fields, pickleball courts, a swimming pool, disc golf, shelter areas, and more. The location also provides convenient access to Eastside shopping, while being just minutes from the campus area and downtown, with easy access to U.S. Highway 63 and Interstate 70 for commuting and travel throughout the area. With its combination of thoughtful renovations, generous living space, flexible bedroom and office arrangements, inviting outdoor areas, and convenient location, this Tanglewood home offers an excellent opportunity for its next owner. Come see this beautiful and renovated Split-Level home and discover everything it has to offer.

items.title: 2662 COUNTY ROAD 1310
items.description: Home to be sold As-Is. Tucked away at the top of a scenic hill and surrounded by mature trees, this truly one-of-a-kind A-frame style home offers a rare blend of privacy, character, and breathtaking views overlooking Sugar Creek Lake. Featuring 4 bedrooms, 3 bathrooms, and a 3-car carport, this secluded retreat feels worlds away while still being conveniently close to town. The heart of the home is the expansive second-level great room, where soaring ceilings, abundant natural light, and a wood-burning stove create a warm and inviting atmosphere. Step out onto the walk-out deck and take in the peaceful lake views, with cascading access down to a patio area below--perfect for relaxing or entertaining in a tranquil, natural setting. A unique and highly functional feature of this home is ground-level access to the second floor from the backside, making it ideal for an in-home office, in-law arrangement, or easy access without stairs. The main and upper levels both offer wood-burning stoves, adding charm and supplemental heat, while a loft area above provides additional flexible space for a reading nook, studio, or guest accommodations. Complete privacy, a serene wooded setting, and priceless lake views define this property, where bald eagles are known to nest nearby and nature is always on display. Dock access is conveniently located by the road below the property, with nearby public picnic and fishing areas enhancing the lifestyle this location offers. With vision and sweat equity, this home presents an incredible opportunity to create your own personal retreat and peaceful haven. This is a rare chance to own a secluded lake-view property with unmatched character and potential.
